scope.search_mode: GitHub public code search and repository-name/description search, supplemented by direct inspection of named source files and immutable revisions

Subtype_evDir.interpretation: No text/code-search match surfaced in the seven selected public repositories for the historical field name.

Point_data.pkl.interpretation: No text/code-search match surfaced in the six selected related repositories outside the paper repository. GitHub text search does not inspect the binary pickle payload itself; the known binary artifact is separately identified by commit, Git blob and SHA-256.

evDir.interpretation: No text/code-search match surfaced in the selected related public repository code.

coord_eig_decomp.additional_direct_inspection: GeoJax/GeoJax/alignment.py at the pinned pre-artifact commit also defines coord_eig_decomp; this was confirmed by fetching the exact file, irrespective of code-search indexing.

coordinate_pca.interpretation: These are general PCA/metric implementations or later public consumers; no matched file binds them to the December 2025 evDir fields.

PC1_angle.interpretation: The public Metrics1 notebook computes PC1_angle from a sign-aligned PC1 vector and the y/z basis, but it does not define or write Subtype_evDir_x/y/z.

direct_source_inspections.observation: coord_eig_decomp returns eigenvalues/eigenvectors; align_point_cloud applies caller-supplied axis order/sign alignment and returns rotated coordinates, not a Subtype_evDir vector table.
install_requires contains jax and jaxlib without version pins, so this packaging file does not identify an exact JAX runtime.
The legacy coord_eig_decomp is a NumPy/scikit-learn PCA candidate, but no inspected function names or writes the historical Subtype_evDir fields.
The currently public coordinate_pca path is a later public API and cannot by itself establish the December 2025 execution revision.
The later notebook has 23 metric columns, omits the three historical evDir fields, and has no active bulk apply/concat/pickle-save producer sequence.
The inspected README contributes no Point_data or PCA producer evidence.
The inspected README describes a future optional visual-system submodule, not the historical morphology metric producer.

repository_name_search.interpretation: The public repository-name/description search returned no matching repository. This does not exclude a private repository, unindexed repository, or local-only directory.

not_proven: That the December 2025 Point_data producer lived in any one of the searched repositories.
That GeoJax/JAX generated the historical Subtype_evDir_x/y/z fields.
That the historical execution installed the JAX version compatible with the pickle serializer fingerprint.
That no source existed in a private/local workspace, notebook autosave, unindexed branch, or deleted repository.

public_issue_search.scope: GitHub issue/PR search, scoped to the same seven related public repositories listed in scope.repositories
public_issue_search.interpretation: No matching public issue or pull-request discussion was returned for these exact queries in the selected repositories. This is a bounded search result, not proof that private discussions, deleted issues, or unsearched repositories do not exist.

history_folder.interpretation: The currently reachable public .history folder exposes editor-history snapshots for README, conda-environment and Python source files only. It contains no Notebook/ or Data/ history path, and no filename matching the historical Point_data producer.

matching_commits.message: Paper submission update. Remove tracked Data artifacts and add preprocessing notebooks and revised analysis code.

metrics1_point_data_notebook.interpretation: The public producer-like Metrics1 notebook has one path-specific commit in the inspected current main history, dated 2026-08-10, well after the December 2025 binary artifact.

commits_returned_by_path_query.message: Paper submission update. Remove tracked Data artifacts and add preprocessing notebooks and revised analysis code.

point_data_pickle.interpretation: The public path history shows addition and later removal of the binary file, not an accompanying source-generation notebook in those changes. Earlier evidence separately records the parallel add commit and first public blob identity.

public_repository_surface.caveat: This is the current reachable public repository surface, not a guarantee that no historical deleted branch or private repository ever existed.

conclusion.impact: This narrows the inspected public-source avenues: the current public editor-history folder does not preserve the missing producer-like notebook, while Metrics1_Point_data entered public history in August 2026. The exact December 2025 producer remains unresolved.
